pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderate edge angularity and generally smooth pixel gradients. Individual dark regions on the flank occupy a larger relative spatial area compared to those on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space topological graph of light pelage. Junction nodes consist primarily of tri-point intersections. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform across the visible flank, narrowing slightly at the neck transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the mane from the upper neck to the shoulder region.
